name: Automation {OS}
tagline: Governed automation of a process that was simplified first.

commands.name: /automation-audit <process>
commands.summary: Find and score automation candidates in an approved simplified process.

commands.name: /automate <candidate>
commands.summary: Design the blueprint: steps, exceptions routed, irreversible steps gated.

commands.name: /automate controls <blueprint>
commands.summary: Design idempotency, retries, deduplication, rate limits and alerting.

commands.name: /runbook <automation>
commands.summary: Write the operating runbook, including the manual recovery path.

commands.name: /agent-automation <workflow>
commands.summary: Split a judgment step out to Agent {OS} and keep the deterministic remainder.

commands.name: /automation-review [automation]
commands.summary: Reconcile the claimed effect against the real business outcome.

commands.name: /automation-incident <automation>
commands.summary: Contain, check idempotency, recover, and name the missing control.

commands.name: /automate retire <automation>
commands.summary: Retire an automation and restore the manual path it replaced.

requires_human_approval_for: granting credentials or tool permissions to an automation
automating a decision touching money, legal exposure, health or a customer
creating, modifying or deleting records in a system of record
removing a manual control a human currently performs
retiring an automation others still depend on
